sign-off.yaml: the line from "send" to "record" goes from outside action "send" into context "record": only a step writes to a context, so draw a recorded sign-off as a review whose [yes] leads to a code do step that writes it, something brought in from outside as a connector that a bring-in step reads, then writes, and a copy from one context into another as a step that reads one and writes the other, or, where the copy publishes, as a step in the first one's scope that hands it to a step in the other's, which writes it
